s.note: Kronk is very proud of his spinach puffs
s.how: Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and mix with 150g feta, 150g ricotta, a crushed garlic clove and nutmeg. Spoon onto 2 sheets puff pastry cut into squares, fold, egg wash and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Pull the lever.
Cook 200g quinoa and cool. Toss with 200g corn kernels, a drained tin of black beans, 2 diced tomatoes, red onion and coriander. Dress with lime juice, olive oil and 1 tsp cumin.

m.note: the roadside diner where Kuzco orders the special
m.how: Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 patties and grill hot. Melt cheddar on top and serve on toasted buns with grilled onion and pickles. Fry 1kg potato chips twice. Special for two, or four.

w.note: the kids' birthday surprise in the village
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter, whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 175C for 35 minutes. Frost with 300g icing sugar beaten with 40g cocoa and 80g butter, then add candles.

d.note: a purple corn drink from Peru
d.how: Simmer 250g purple corn with the peel of a pineapple, a cinnamon stick and 4 cloves in 2L water for 45 minutes. Strain, sweeten and chill. Serve with lime juice and diced apple.
